name: feature-pipeline
description: Route a feature through four stages — spec plus acceptance checklist, an outside opinion, implementation, and an independent verification — while the main context only orchestrates and never writes the code itself. Two flavours: feature-pipeline delegates implementation to another agentic harness (Grok Build or DeepSeek); local-pipeline runs every stage on pinned Claude subagents (Fable spec, Opus critique, Sonnet implementation, Opus judge) and relays their questions to the author.
